evidence.title: GitHub - AnmolSaini16/mapcn: Beautiful map components. 100% Free, Zero config, one command setup. · GitHub

name: mapcn
summary: Copy-paste React map components and blocks built on MapLibre GL, installed with the shadcn CLI.
description: A shadcn-style registry of ready-to-use React map components — Map, Controls, Markers, Popups, Routes, Arcs, GeoJSON and Clusters — plus eight pre-built blocks including Analytics Map, Choropleth, Delivery Tracker, Heatmap and Store Locator. Zero-config with free CARTO tiles and no API keys, theme-aware light and dark styles, and support for any MapLibre-compatible tile provider.
contains: components: Map, Controls, Markers, Popups, Routes, Arcs, GeoJSON, Clusters
8 blocks incl. Analytics Map, Choropleth, Delivery Tracker, Uptime Monitor, Heatmap, Store Locator
one command install: npx shadcn@latest add @mapcn/map
free CARTO basemap tiles, no API keys needed; light and dark theme aware
works with any MapLibre-compatible tiles (OpenStreetMap, Carto, MapTiler, Stadia, Thunderforest)
